description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, mathematical operations, and logging, tailored for an environment without standard library malloc. It includes functions like string trimming, comparison, conversion, and mathematical approximations, as well as histogram printing and rate limiting.

methods.name: boolToString
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'Yes' or 'No' string.

methods.name: minI
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two integers.

methods.name: efiRound
methods.description: Rounds a float to the nearest multiple of given precision, with assertion for non-zero precision.

methods.name: absF
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a float.

methods.name: absI
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an int32_t.

methods.name: maxI
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two integers.

methods.name: maxF
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two floats.

methods.name: minF
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two floats.

methods.name: efiStrlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: efiTrim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing spaces from a string.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a character in a string.

methods.name: atoi
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, returns ERROR_CODE on invalid input.

methods.name: itoa10
methods.description: Converts an integer to string in base 10.

methods.name: isSameF
methods.description: Checks if two floats are approximately equal within EPS.

methods.name: efiPow10
methods.description: Returns 10 raised to the power of the input integer.

methods.name: atooff
methods.description: Converts a string to float, supports NaN, handles decimal points.

methods.name: strEqualCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison.

methods.name: mytolower
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase if uppercase.

methods.name: strEqual
methods.description: Case-sensitive string comparison.

methods.name: printHistogram
methods.description: Prints histogram summary if enabled.

methods.name: limitRateOfChange
methods.description: Limits the rate of change of a value based on limits per second.

methods.name: expf_taylor
methods.description: Approximates exponential function using Taylor series.
